items.title: Introduction to Python's unittest and pytest modules

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Introduction to Python's unittest and pytest modules as printed (PDF 65, printed 61); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the Unit Testing lesson.

blocks.text: The unittest module is built into Python and provides a framework for creating test cases. Pytest is an external module that simplifies writing and running tests. Both modules help verify that code behaves as expected. They can test individual functions, classes, or entire modules. Using these tools improves program stability and reduces errors in larger applications.
